title: Wendy’s Honors Veterans and Active-Duty Military with a Free Dave’s Single
body_markdown:
This Veterans Day, Wendy’s is proud to offer veterans and active-duty military a **FREE Dave’s Single*** at participating U.S. restaurants as a gesture of appreciation for their service and sacrifice. And there’s special meaning behind the hamburger we’re serving up.


The Wendy’s family includes many veterans, beginning with our founder, Dave Thomas. Long before opening the first Wendy’s restaurant in 1969, Dave joined the U.S. Army at age 18 and attended the Army’s Cook and Bakers School. While serving in Germany, he rose to the rank of staff sergeant and helped manage the Enlisted Men’s Club, preparing and serving meals for as many as 2,000 people a day. Those early experiences helped Dave develop leadership and culinary skills that would later shape his future in the restaurant business.


That history makes the Dave’s Single an especially fitting way to say thank you. Named after the veteran who founded Wendy’s, the Dave’s Single has roots in Wendy’s original menu and reflects the commitment to quality that has been part of our brand from the beginning.


### **Here Are the Details**


- **When?** Veterans Day – Wednesday, November 11, 2026
- **Who?** Veterans and active-duty military members.
- **How?** Simply identify yourself as a veteran or active-duty military member.
- **Where?** Visit your participating Wendy’s and order inside or through the drive-thru.


Dave Thomas believed deeply in "Doing the Right Thing" and "Giving Something Back." Those values continue to guide Wendy's today, and Veterans Day is an opportunity to put them into action by recognizing those who have served – and continue to serve – our country.


Wendy's is proud to be an employer of veterans, and we're grateful for the dedication our veteran employees bring to their work every day. To all of our veterans and active-duty military members: thank you for your service!


*** *No purchase necessary. Limit one (1) free Dave’s Single per person. Offer valid only for Veteran or Active-Duty Military Members at participating U.S. Wendy’s restaurants on November 11, 2026. Not valid in a combo or with any other offers or discounts. No substitutions. Not valid for digital, delivery or kiosk orders.*
